feed.title: Mobile DNA, Evolutionary Dynamics, and Genome Ecology Lab
feed.subtitle: We are fascinated by the mechanisms that drive genome innovation and host adaption across the tree of life. By combining comparative genomics, evolutionary theory, and computational biology, we seek to understand how mobile DNA influences genome structure, adaptation, and biodiversity across deep evolutionary time.

entry.title: Toby joins NRM as a DDLS Fellow!

link.title: Toby joins NRM as a DDLS Fellow!

entry.content: Toby has joined the Naturhistoriska Riksmuseet (Swedish Museum of Natural History) in Stockholm, Sweden as a DDLS Fellow. He will be working on understanding the mechanisms shaping genome structure, adaptation, and biodiversity across the tree of life. Check out our open positions if you are interested in joining the lab!
